info.title: ProjectConnect API
info.description: Generated registered route inventory. Shared typed contracts currently cover portability/roadmap/sitemap; other payload schemas remain incomplete and this is NOT a fully typed client contract. Public/session optional behavior is described in API.md; conservative cookie security labels do not replace server authorization.
